modes.src: mode = GameData+0x92e0 (0 NORMAL, 1 HARD, 2 HELL). Monster::Init_Monster001 @0x5729e8: HARD ATK = trunc(ATK*1.5); HELL ATK = trunc(ATK*2) and walkTime *0.85 (HP, DEF, score unchanged). Coin value per drop (Scene_UI::FUC_SELECT_ITEM @0x5eda54): 1 / 2 (HARD) / 3 (HELL), 4 in HELL once that stage has both HELL challenges (star table >= 9 and HELL UNTOUCHED). Labels: libMyGame.so strings "HARD (GOLD x2)", "HELL (GOLD x3)", "HELL (GOLD x4)". The score target T has no mode index (Info_MissionTarget), so stars use the same marks.

challenges.src: per stage, star table GameData+0x4f88[stage] = mode*3 + stars, kept at its max (FUC_SHOW_RESULT_STAR_ANI @0x600174 writes 1/4/7 for the first star in NORMAL/HARD/HELL); UNTOUCHED per mode at GameData+0x5758 + mode*0x7d0 + stage*8 = 9999 after a clear in that mode with the UNTOUCHED flag (FUC_SHOW_RESULT_END @0x5fba50). Opening the prep picks the highest open mode (Scene_WorldMap::onTouchesEnded @0x56f940): HARD when star table >= 3 and NORMAL untouched, HELL when star table >= 6 and HARD untouched. Texts "HARD MODE UNLOCKED", "HELL MODE UNLOCKED". UNTOUCHED = cleared without taking a hit (game text "USE THE DIVINE SHIELD TO HELP CLEAR STAGE WITH NO HIT").
